svg.title: Phase 1 full architecture
svg.desc: Internet and gateway feeding a VPC with route tables, two public and two private subnets, NAT gateway, ALB with its security group, and an Auto Scaling Group of instances with their security group, plus target group, launch template, scaling policy and CloudWatch alarms.

g.text: Public route table: 0.0.0.0/0 to IGW (2 associations)
ALB security group: port 80 from internet

svg.text: ALB + listener :80, spans both public subnets (next)

g.text: Private route table: 0.0.0.0/0 to NAT (2 associations)
Instance SG: port 80 from ALB SG only
Instance SG: port 80 from ALB SG only

svg.text: Attached to the ALB and ASG, not inside a subnet (all next)
Solid = built (16). Dashed = next (6). Amber = costs while idle. Purple = security groups.
